title: Hyperbolic Hierarchical Clustering for Visual Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.22665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate the token mixer in vision backbones by revisiting clustering, one of the most classic approaches in machine learning. An effective token mixer is a fundamental component of modern vision backbones like vision Transformers, facilitating information exchange between image patches. Mainstream token mixers, which rely on convolution, attention, MLP, or their hybrids, primarily focus on navigating the trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. However, a significant drawback of these methods is their black-box nature; their encoding process is opaque and lacks interpretability. Diverging from these opaque designs, we introduce ClusterMixer, a transparent token mixer that is grounded in a clustering paradigm and interpretable by design. translated_title: 用于视觉表示学习的双曲层次聚类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22665v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们通过重新审视机器学习中最经典的方法之一——聚类，来研究视觉骨干网络中的令牌混合器。有效的令牌混合器是现代视觉骨干网络（如视觉Transformer）的基本组件，促进图像块之间的信息交换。主流令牌混合器依赖卷积、注意力、MLP或其混合方式，主要关注在准确性和计算成本之间权衡。然而，这些方法的一个显著缺点是它们的黑盒性质；其编码过程不透明，缺乏可解释性。与这些不透明设计不同，我们引入了ClusterMixer，一种基于聚类范式且设计上可解释的透明令牌混合器。ClusterMixer通过层次聚类机制明确地表述令牌混合过程。为了建模视觉数据中固有的自然树状关系，我们使用双曲空间来嵌入聚类结构。
tldr: 本文提出ClusterMixer，一种基于双曲层次聚类的可解释令牌混合器，替代黑盒混合方法，提升视觉表示学习的透明性和性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ClusterMixer, an interpretable token mixer based on hyperbolic hierarchical clustering, replacing black-box mixing methods to enhance transparency and performance in visual representation learning.
